newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi 3-month T-Bill rate up to 14.06 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi 3-month T-Bill rate up to 14.06 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills rose by 0.20 percent to 14.06 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 13.86 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Wednesday.
Applications for 19.08 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 96.6 percent.

The average rate for six-month bills picked up by 0.10 percent to 15.43 percent from 15.33 percent two weeks ago. Applications for the 46.1 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 93.11 percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate rose by 0.12 percent to 15.24 from 15.12 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 45.5 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 90.9 percent.
